name: quickbite-root
description: QuickBite – Microservices-Based Food Delivery Platform with Centralized API Gateway

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,RESTAURANT,ORDER,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,RESTAURANT,ORDER" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:order"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix gateway run build && npm --prefix services/auth-service run build && npm --prefix services/user-service run build && npm --prefix services/restaurant-service run build && npm --prefix services/order-service run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
